description: Get all 42 technical analysis indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Ichimoku, etc.) for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol returns one indicators object; multiple symbols return a paginated batch plus per-symbol errors.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

limit.description: Maximum symbols per page (only applies when multiple symbols given); omitted = curated default (25)

symbols.description: One or more comma-separated ticker symbols (e.g., "AAPL" or "AAPL,MSFT,GOOG")

name: get_indicators
title: Technical Indicators
